description: This file defines the Zone model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for retrieving zone information from the database, such as getting a specific zone, retrieving zones by country ID with caching, and counting total zones for a country.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Model class for handling localisation zone data, including retrieval and counting of zone records from the database.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves a zone record by its primary key ID, returning zone details as an array.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves all zones associated with a specific country ID, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total count of zones for a specified country ID.
